name: Hikari
source:
A girl whom [url=/c68683]Tsuu's[/url] squad found while investigating the underground caverns. She has the ability to instantly lighten up the atmosphere around her. She is also childhood friends with [url=/c76980]Mamoru[/url].

She is often found at the rescue center where she tends to the survivors and the Märchens working under [url=/c72798]Hameln[/url].
